name: Pigment yellow 194
description: Pigment Yellow 194 (CAS 82199-12-0 ), commercially known as Novoperm Yellow F 2G and classified under CI 11785, is a high-performance organic pigment used to deliver bright, durable yellow coloration across demanding industrial applications. It is valued in formulations where color strength, heat stability, and resistance to migration are critical sourcing criteria. In plastics and polymer processing, it performs reliably at elevated processing temperatures. This makes it suitable for engineering resins and masterbatch production. Coatings and industrial paint formulators use it to achieve clean, saturated yellow hues with strong lightfastness in both solvent-borne and water-borne systems. Printing inks for packaging, including flexographic and gravure applications, rely on it for consistent color reproduction and resistance to bleed. Textile and leather finishing operations also incorporate it where a stable tone is required. Pigment Yellow 194 is supplied as a dry powder, the standard commercial form for pigment dispersion into various carrier systems. It is available in technical grade, with press cake forms offered by some producers. These forms facilitate dispersion in aqueous systems. Buyers should confirm tinting strength, particle size distribution, and oil absorption values against specification sheets when evaluating lots for their specific manufacturing needs.
